threshold_intro: Every threshold below is the rule applied when scoring the findings on the other sheets in this workbook. Only the review areas the supplied criteria asked about are listed. A row is rated against the worst threshold it crosses.
band_intro: The measured value alone places a finding in a band. Where a row reports several metrics, the worst band wins.
